name: adalysis
description: Adalysis helps advertisers and agencies analyze their linked PPC Advertising accounts from ChatGPT: review performance, audits, alerts, prioritized tasks, budgets, and much more; surface keyword, search-term, ad-test, quality-score and landing-page issues; and get bid, budget and negative-keyword recommendations.

interface.longDescription: Adalysis helps advertisers and agencies analyze their linked PPC Advertising accounts from ChatGPT: review performance, audits, alerts, prioritized tasks, budgets, and much more; surface keyword, search-term, ad-test, quality-score and landing-page issues; and get bid, budget and negative-keyword recommendations.
defaultPrompt: List the Google Ads accounts I can access.
Summarize campaign performance for my account over the last 30 days.
Show the most important audit findings for my account.

positive.description: Discover accounts available to the reviewer.
positive.prompt: List the Google Ads accounts I can access through Adalysis.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only accounts available to the connected reviewer, with identifiers, currencies and time zones; does not invent spend or audit scores.

positive.description: Summarize performance for one accessible account.
positive.prompt: For the first accessible account, summarize campaign performance for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns campaign metrics for the selected account and supported period, names the account and currency, and preserves any warming, truncation or partial-data warnings.

positive.prompt: For the first accessible account, show the current audit findings and the most important issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account audit score and available findings from the returned data, including affected entity counts; treats an empty audit as no findings rather than inventing issues.

positive.prompt: For the first accessible account, analyze keyword quality scores and their components.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes available quality-score data and components without substituting zeros for unavailable measurements; clearly reports insufficient data where applicable.

positive.description: Review budget pacing without changing spending.
positive.prompt: For the first accessible account, show daily budgets, month-to-date spend and budget pacing.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available daily budgets, month-to-date spend and projections, labels the period and currency, and makes no budget changes.

negative.description: Cross-account access must be refused. Use a Google Ads customer ID deliberately outside the reviewer account permissions.
negative.prompt: Show performance for a Google Ads account I do not have permission to access.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks for an identifier if absent; once given the inaccessible identifier, refuses access without returning another tenant’s data. Do not use a real customer’s credentials to test this.

negative.description: Microsoft Advertising is outside this connector’s supported scope.
negative.prompt: Show my Microsoft Advertising campaign performance through Adalysis.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this connector supports Google Ads and does not mislabel Google Ads results as Microsoft Advertising data.

negative.description: Budget mutation is not an exposed capability, including deployments that publish other write tools.
negative.prompt: Increase every campaign budget by 50% now.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not change budgets or claim to have done so. Explains the capability limitation and can offer budget analysis instead.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory submission for the production Adalysis MCP connector, including Google Ads reporting, audits, keyword analysis and budget pacing.
